Elon Musk and Donald Trump Jr. amplified a fabricated E! News video — traced to a Russian disinformation network called Pravda — falsely claiming USAID paid celebrities like Ben Stiller and Angelina Jolie for Ukraine propaganda trips. Trump separately claimed USAID sent '$50 million in condoms to Hamas,' a claim fact-checked as false by multiple outlets including DW and Reuters. original_title: Trump Fires NLRB Members, Paralyzing Labor Enforcement Agency

existing.title: Trump Fires NLRB Members, Paralyzing Labor Enforcement Agency
existing.description_short: Trump Fires NLRB Members, Paralyzing Labor Enforcement Agency
existing.description_long: On January 28, 2025, Trump fired two Democratic National Labor Relations Board officials: board member Gwynne Wilcox, whose term ran until August 2028, and General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo. The removal of Wilcox was described by labor law experts as unprecedented in the agency's history and potentially a violation of federal labor law. With two pre-existing vacancies, the loss of Wilcox left the NLRB with only two members — far short of the three-member quorum needed to decide cases. Hundreds of pending cases accusing companies of unlawful labor practices were brought to a standstill. Abruzzo, who served as the agency's prosecutor, had aggressively pursued worker protections during the Biden years. The dual firing effectively rendered the NLRB unable to enforce labor law and paved the way for Republican-only control of the board, benefiting major corporations facing union organizing and unfair labor practice charges.
